specification.interpretation: The 0.10 exclusive-self-time share is a diagnostic materiality marker only; it does not automatically justify an optimization. Any changed loop/allocation accounting requires a separate public-vector admission review.
specification.profile_scope: One cProfile capture around solve_preflop and JSON serialization only. Runouts/options are prepared before profiling; independent numeric replay and rational posterior verification occur after profiling. No tracemalloc, memory claim, paired runtime comparison, or solver run before the frozen source merge.

vector_work_budget.loop_entry_scope: Conservative modeled vector-backend validation, aggregation, row setup/normalization, training, and diagnostic loop envelope; not bytecode count, runtime, or process RSS. World enumeration and tree construction use separate existing guards.

future_grouping.grouping_loop_entry_scope: Conservative linear validation, hash/group accumulation, and output-copy envelope; not bytecode, elapsed time, Python-allocation, or RSS prediction.

vector_work_budget.future_grouping_admission_scope: Original-world vector, prefix, dense, action-slot, grouping and copy caps remain enforced. Physical-world construction separately uses ten iterations per row; the full requested ceiling remains charged by vector/grouping admission.
vector_work_budget.world_admission_scope: Only the legacy physical-world-count times requested-iterations guard is replaced by a ten-iteration physical-row construction cap. The original-world vector, prefix, dense, action-slot, grouping and copy caps remain enforced; full requested iterations remain charged in vector/grouping work.

interpretation: A single instrumented profile locates work; its elapsed time is not a performance benchmark. No memory trace was collected.
model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with three weighted exact combos per player, two selected flops, 4,704 ordered future candidates and 27,720 compatible physical worlds, and forced checkdown after flop betting. One shared 10-chip stack, two requested iteration ceilings, configured preflop raises/all-ins and rich flop actions. Not broad-range/full-deck, all-streets, multiway, unrestricted NLHE, or a general convergence claim.
